detailed_description:
Photoreal live-action, London, March 1881, gas lamp from the right, black shadow, 35 mm film grain.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:02. The shot begins from <Picture 2>: a close shot of Jefferson Hope's face on the box in the rain under the low black cap, the full black beard wet, the dark eyes fixed on the road, the lamplight from the right on the wet cheek. The camera is beside the box level with his eyes, an arm's length from him, a 90mm lens. The gas lamp comes from the RIGHT. At the first frame Jefferson Hope's face fills the CENTRE of the frame, half the frame height, from the wet beard at the BOTTOM third to the hat's brim at the TOP edge, lit from the RIGHT. The rain slants across the black street behind him. The camera pans left across the whole shot, travelling a finger's breadth as the black street keeps the frame behind him, from 00:00 to 00:01. At 00:01 rain runs off the hat's brim, then his chin lifts a finger's breadth, and the lift continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:02 the camera is panning left through the last frame, and the action continues with it.
